Group rides in Colorado

19 recurring group rides around Colorado: 10 road, 6 mountain bike, 4 gravel. 12 roll on weeknights, 4 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Tour de Latte in Colorado Springs — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Wednesday Morning Velo runs six groups; slowest 13–15 mph.
